proven.evidence: GACC Announcement 2026 No.24 made 9610 cross-customs-district returns nationally available from 2026-04-01; real Hangzhou and Yiwu flows demonstrate that returned goods can use different China re-entry locations.
4PX exposes a unified logistics open platform including return services; Cainiao exposes sales-return and warehouse-return APIs; AfterShip exposes a complete returns API and carrier/routing controls.

decisive_kills.reason: Public evidence shows multiple physical ports/routes and generic logistics return APIs, but does not establish two independent rails that expose the exact 9610 cross-customs re-entry transaction to a neutral third-party router with structured quote/order/status/outcome exchange.

Real examples are platform/enterprise coordinated; AliExpress stated the enterprise can choose a convenient return port, while the GACC rule requires participating enterprise production systems to expose data to or connect with Customs. The decisive execution relationship is therefore embedded in platform/enterprise/customs operations rather than an open neutral routing rail.
No native payout, take-rate or machine contribution payment for a neutral 9610 routing operator was established. Cost reduction to the seller does not itself prove a third-party revenue rail.

No public evidence establishes rights for an independent router to retain and combine provider-specific 9610 reverse-cost, customs-clearance, inbound-time and recoverability outcomes into a cross-provider compounding asset.

AfterShip Returns already provides return zones/routing rules, carrier accounts, real-time multi-carrier rate comparison, cheapest-carrier selection, labels and a full returns API. The general return-routing value layer is mature, leaving only the special 9610 customs-action layer—which is precisely the part whose neutral third-party callability is unproven.

evidence.title: GACC Announcement 2026 No.24
evidence.fact: Nationwide 9610 cross-customs-district returns are allowed from 2026-04-01; participating enterprises need dedicated operational capability and production-system data must be opened to or connected with Customs.

evidence.title: Hangzhou airport first 2026 cross-customs 9610 returns
evidence.fact: Goods originally exported through Shanghai and Shenzhen returned through Hangzhou, proving real cross-district physical execution.

evidence.title: Zhejiang cross-customs returns and Yiwu TIR mode
evidence.fact: AliExpress described choosing a convenient return port; Yiwu TIR return mode had processed about 26.5k parcels and reported about 40% lower logistics cost than air.

evidence.title: 4PX Open Platform
evidence.fact: 4PX offers unified REST logistics APIs to merchants and software providers, and its API catalog includes return services; this proves generic logistics callability, not the exact neutral 9610 customs rail.

evidence.title: Cainiao warehouse return APIs
evidence.fact: Cainiao exposes sales-return notification and return-receipt APIs requiring authorization; this establishes structured warehouse-return exchange but not independent cross-customs 9610 route selection.

evidence.title: AfterShip Returns
evidence.fact: AfterShip exposes return creation/approval/rejection/receipt APIs and routing rules, while current product docs support carrier setup and cheapest-carrier selection through real-time rate comparison.
